notes.title: Владельцы PlayStation 5 проигнорировали бывший Xbox-эксклюзив Senua's Saga: Hellblade II — аналитики
notes.content: В этом году мы неоднократно слышали об успехах бывших эксклюзивов Xbox на PlayStation 5. notes.title: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II gets Steam Deck Verified with the Enhanced Update out now
notes.content:
The Enhanced Update has arrived for Senua's Saga: Hellblade II, bringing with it optimisations, Steam Deck Verified support and more.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/senuas-saga-hellblade-ii-gets-steam-deck-verified-with-the-enhanced-update-out-now/

notes.title: Enhanced Update Out Now
notes.content: [p]The Enhanced update for Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II has arrived, and with it, comes some new features and enhancements for you to explore.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Very High[/b][/p][p]When the game launched last year we offered Low, Medium and High graphics presets. With this update we’ve made some select visual enhancements to take advantage of newer, more powerful hardware, which you can enable with our new ‘Very High’ graphics preset. Rather than dialling everything up, our team carefully considered where we could make the most impactful improvements for a visual quality bump at a reasonable performance cost. The result sees more detailed and accurate shadows, improved AntiAliasing, better post-processing such as depth of field, motion blur and bloom. Very High will also offer increased view distances and improved volumetrics. For those with hardware that supports it, we’ve also included DLSS 4 and Multi Frame Generation for boosted frame rates.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ZZovyEHQ4Ko;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Steam Deck[/b][/p][p]Something else we wanted to revisit with this update was performance on Steam Deck to achieve Verified compatibility, and we’re pleased to report that this work was successful. Deck performance at launch wasn’t an out-of-the-box experience, so players would find themselves needing to tweak settings to achieve optimal performance. We’ve now made the game ‘Deck-aware’, so the game will now automatically select the best settings for this hardware. We’ve also found some CPU performance improvements for a better game experience on Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New features[/b][/p][p]Once you have completed the game, you’ll now unlock two new ways to experience Senua’s story. Select Dev Commentary mode to hear from our team, cast and collaborators as you play. You’ll learn about the craft, care and creative decisions that went into making Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II. For those looking for a challenge, Dark Rot mode will truly put your skills to the test. Not only is the combat harder in this mode, but die too many times and the Dark Rot will consume Senua, wiping  your progress. Sound familiar? [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237048/a6eb0743f9cc54a5dd76e9099ccfd4cc0cd9e8f6.png"][/img][/p][p]For the virtual photographers, we’ve added some new photo mode features to push your creativity even further. Motion, ambient sounds and music can now be added to your captures. We’ve also made some improvements to a range of settings to make sure you have the tools you need to capture incredible images from the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy these new enhancements and features, whether you’re a returning player, or you’re embarking on Senua’s quest to Iceland for the first time.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the full patch notes:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2461850/view/528728489311864169?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II Enhanced Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Dark Rot mode can be selected after completing the game.
[*] Dark Rot Achievement added.
[*] Developer Commentary can be selected after completing the game.
[*] Very High graphs preset added.
[*] DLSS4 / Multi Frame Gen.
[*] Dolby Atmos for speakers.
[*] Enhanced Photo mode.
[*] Steam Deck Verified + performance improvements.
[*] DualSense controller support.
[*] Fixed overlaps present in localised languages in pause menu when text size is set to large.
[*] Fixed Senua's hair turning white when she steps into the light in Chapter 4 "Act of Sacrifice".
[*] Fixed a bug where changing upscaler for the first time does not load upscaler quality mode properly
[*] Fixed Senua's hair sometimes turning white when using Intel XeSS or AMD FSR Ultra Performance mode in Chapter 2 "Return Home".
[*] Fixed a bug where holding input does not always work for getting up, when button mash input method is set as ‘Hold’.
[*] Fixed speaker colour settings.
[*] Fixed an enemy encounter in the 2nd fight of Chapter 6 where an opponent continues an attack sequence after Senua is knocked down on the ground against a wall.
[*] Fixed Senua's footprints moving alongside her in Chapter 4 caves after the ‘Trial of Wisdom’ checkpoint, if reached in asingle game session that started in a previous chapter's checkpoint.
[*] Fixed Senua dying after climbing elevated ground in the first part of the Sea Giant's ritual in Chapter 5.
[*] Fixed assets without collision spawning after skipping a cinematic with Astridr in the forest, during Chapter 6.
[*] Fixed a Hiddenfolk puzzle disappearing if the graphic preset is changed.
[*] Fixed the speaker disappearing from the subtitles after pausing and resuming the game.
[*] Fixed Thorgestr and Senua's subtitles not syncing with audio during the Draugr fight at the settlement in Chapter 5
[*] Fixed The Goði spawning on screen behind Senua if she performs the neck breaking animation on the last Axe Northman warrior
[*] Fixed Northman enemies spinning around jarringly if attacked in the back with Focus attacks during Chapter 6.
[*] Fixed a red light highlighting Senua after the 4th fight with devourers during a checkpoint.
[*] Several menu narration fixes across the board.
[/list]

notes.title: Сенуа возвращается на PlayStation: Ninja Theory рассказала о Senua's Saga: Hellblade II Enhanced для PlayStation 5
notes.content: Через 16 часов состоится релиз Senua's Saga: Hellblade II для PlayStation 5 и PlayStation 5 Pro. Приключенческий экшен выйдет на новой платформе в версии Enhanced, что говорит о различных улучшениях, которые провели разработчики.

notes.title: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II показали на PlayStation 5 Pro
notes.content: Завтра Senua's Saga: Hellblade II переберётся с Xbox Series X|S и PC на PlayStation 5 и PlayStation 5 Pro. Кроме того, разработчики готовят крупное обновление ранее выпущенных версий с поддержкой режима производительности 60 FPS на консолях, очень высокие настройки графики на ПК и оптимизацию для Steam Deck.

notes.title: Владельцы PlayStation 5, встречайте! Microsoft датировала выход Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II Enhanced — что она предложит

notes.title: Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II Enhanced Arrives August 12
notes.content: [p]Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II Enhanced, a special update with new features and ways to experience the game, arrives on Steam August 12. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237048/1af4587cadda33df6d9e2a4280d74de2c31da442.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Pushing Performance[/b][/p][p]Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II is a cinematic experience of immersion where we push real-time visuals to deliver rich, believable environments and characters to sink you deep into Senua’s story. In this update we’re adding a new ‘Very High’ graphics preset to push the visuals even further, and we’re also happy to confirm that the game will be Steam Deck Verified when the update drops in August.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]The Dark Rot Returns[/b][/p][p]The Dark Rot from Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice has returned and offers an additional challenge for Senua on her quest to Iceland in this optional game mode. The Dark Rot will grow each time you fail, and if it reaches Senua’s head, her quest is over and all progress will be lost.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237048/a6eb0743f9cc54a5dd76e9099ccfd4cc0cd9e8f6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237048/58a6fcaa6c16728dc46023ad58fc5bf2881a3445.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237048/7561f9ac79ec113bbf94a0de8dbbd8454664e1b8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237048/340864630ef35b74eef7d27a09dc927c4b09798a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237048/8bb67949e548cf401465070306849637f8b292a3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237048/849456d1d6e23d8740f62e0eb7d367e638794750.png"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Enhanced Photo Mode[/b][/p][p]We’re really excited to offer an enhanced set of tools for virtual photographers with our updated photo mode, as well as an all-new ‘Motion’ tab for custom cinematic video capture. We can’t wait to see what you create with these new tools.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Developer Commentary[/b][/p][p]Hear from the Ninja Theory team, cast and collaborators as you play through the game, with insights into the craft, and creative decisions that went into making Senua's Saga: Hellblade II.[/p][p] [/p][p]Whether you’re a returning player or brand new to Senua’s story, there will be plenty to explore when [i]Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II Enhanced[/i] arrives on Steam as a free update August 12.[/p]

notes.title: Официально: Xbox-эксклюзив Senua's Saga: Hellblade II отправляется на PlayStation 5 — Microsoft выпустит порт уже этим летом
notes.content: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II потеряет статус консольного эксклюзива Xbox Series X|S и уже летом этого года выйдет на PlayStation 5, объявила студия Ninja Theory. Владельцы консолей Sony смогут купить сразу улучшенную версию приключения с подзаголовком Enhanced — покупатели игры на платформах Microsoft получат все обновления бесплатно.

notes.title: Разработчики Xbox-эксклюзива Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II из Ninja Theory активно трудятся над следующей игрой
notes.content: Выпустившая в прошлом году приключение Senua's Saga: Hellblade II (наш обзор) студия Ninja Theory активно трудится над новым проектом. Разработчики выложили у себя в соцсетях фото команды, рассматривающей экран — изображение на нём намеренно размыто.

notes.title: Xbox-эксклюзив Senua's Saga: Hellblade II лидирует по количеству номинаций на престижную премию BAFTA Games Awards 2025
notes.content: Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II лидирует по количеству номинаций на престижную британскую премию BAFTA Games Awards 2025 — игра Microsoft и Ninja Theory претендует на 11 наград. За ней следуют Astro Bot от Sony и Still Wakes the Deep от The Chinese Room – у них по 8 номинаций.

notes.title: Создатели Senua's Saga: Hellblade II ищут опытного дизайнера боевой системы для разработки новой игры на Unreal Engine 5
notes.content: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II (наш обзор) стала примером современного визуального совершенства, но разочаровала многих игроков геймплеем — в сети её нередко называли "технодемкой" и "симулятором ходьбы". Следующий проект Ninja Theory должен получиться другим — в нем будет уделяться гораздо больше внимания сражениям, в том числе с серьезными боссами.

notes.title: Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II Takes Home Two Wins at The Game Awards
notes.content:
Last week saw the 10th anniversary of The Game Awards hosted by Geoff Keighley, celebrating the best games of the year and giving us a glimpse of what’s to come from your favourite game studios in 2025 and beyond.

We’re no stranger to The Game Awards, you might remember last year we debuted a trailer for Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II after an epic performance from Heilung, and we announced our game at the show in 2019. It was a pleasure then to return this year with four nominations:

•	Best Audio Design
•	Best Performance
•	Best Narrative 
•	Games for Impact

Ninja Studio Head Dom Matthews, Ninja Audio Director David Garcia Diaz, and Senua herself, Melina Juergens, represented the studio this year. We’re incredibly happy to share that we brought home not one, but two awards.

First up was Melina’s incredible win for Best Performance, which was presented by actor Troy Baker, Bethesda’s Todd Howard, and the original Indiana Jones himself, Harrison Ford! Melina is actually the first person to win this award twice, so it felt extra special. Watch her receive the award here:

[previewyoutube=fJNiGoaqVNI;full][/previewyoutube]

We were also honoured to pick up the award for Best Audio Design. As you know, great care and effort went into our audio design not only to create an immersive world for players using binaural audio, but also to give players the opportunity to experience Senua’s unshared reality of hearing voices that others don’t. 

Winning these awards means a great deal to us at the studio. Our mission is to craft life-changing art with game-changing tech, and these awards are proof that we’re on the right path. Thank you to everyone who voted for us, and if you haven’t played the game yet, there are still a couple of days left to pick it up in The Game Awards sale for 50% off, our biggest discount yet.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461850/Senuas_Saga_Hellblade_II/

notes.title: Patch Notes – 31st May 2024
notes.content:
Hi everyone. We hope you’ve been enjoying Senua’s new journey into Viking Iceland. Today we have some small fixes to improve the game experience. 

[list]
[*] Added a warning prompt when selecting ‘New Story’ as this option resets the current save's story progress. 
[*] Fixed the large text size option, which was causing UI elements in chapter selection to go out of bounds. 
[*] Animation sync issues during some enemy executions in combat have been adjusted and fixed. 
[*] Adjusted the combat events during the Thórgestr battle at the end of Chapter 1 
[*] Several localization fixes. 
[*] Tree collision fixes in Chapter 2 settlement puzzle. 
[*] Fixed the crash when closing photo mode after extended gameplay. 
[*] Fixed a few cases of memory leaks game-wide. 
[*] Ultrawide fix during Chapter 3 cinematic to prevent Fargrímr from disappearing. 
[*] Indoor rain inside the broken house in Chapter 1 is fixed. 
[*] Ghosting issues fixed when running Frame Generation. 
[*] Added missing SFX during Chapter 3 puzzle and Chapter 4 combat 
[*] Fixed missing captions in several areas across the game. 
[*] Missing facial animations in Chapter 5 cinematic after village battle. 
[*] Misaligned peach fuzz around Senua's neck and face has been corrected. 
[*] Goði combat crowd push events have been adjusted for a better combat experience. 
[*] Improved FSR3 artefacts. 
[*] Fixed the case of some animated objects were invisible during gameplay. 
[*] Fixed instances of black marks appearing on faces around beards and fine hairs on Low preset.

notes.title: All Hellblade 2 hidden face locations in Senua's Saga
notes.content:
Where are the Hellblade 2 hidden face locations? Senua's Saga is all about perspective, and Hellblade 2's collectibles certainly force you to look at the environment differently. These rock formations resemble human faces and unlock stories that explore many of the notable trickster gods, spirits, and monsters that spell doom and misfortune in Icelandic folklore. Like Druth's stories, these Norse tales recontextualize Senua's Saga within the history and culture in which it takes place.

There are 17 hidden faces to locate in Hellblade 2, and many are tough to spot. They appear in chapters two through five in the story game, and you can reveal the hidden path behind them using your Focus ability. However, it's important to bear in mind that Hellblade 2 faces are only marked as collected once you've used Focus to activate the tree of Yggdrasil that lies beyond. Here's where to find the Hellblade 2 faces - we also recommend looking out for the Hellblade 2 Lorestangir along the way.

Where are the Hellblade 2 Lorestangir locations? Senua's Saga might take her to the distant shores of Iceland, but it'll take more than that to get rid of our old buddy Druth. Hellblade 2 Lorestangir are the equivalent of Lorestones from Senua's Sacrifice. These collectible totems contain a fragment of the skáldic verse that follows Grettir the Strong, narrated by Druth.

There are 18 Lorestangir in Hellblade 2 in total, and they can be located in chapters one through five. You can activate the Lorestangir using your Focus ability, just like Hellblade 2 hidden faces. Once activated, the rune displayed on the lorestone turns red and Druth narrates the relevant fragment of the verse. Like the Norse tales told during Senua's descent into Hel in Senua's Sacrifice, Grettir's verse offers a new way of interpreting the events of Senua's Saga. notes.title: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II is coming May 21, 2024
notes.content:
[i]The following post was originally published on Xbox Wire.[/i]

Hello, Dom Matthews here, Studio Head at Ninja Theory. As I write this, we are now in the final few months of development on Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II, preparing for our launch Day One on Xbox Game Pass and across Xbox Series X|S, Windows and Steam on May 21. It was a pleasure to give you all a deeper insight into Senua’s next journey, our studio and our talented team in Developer Direct. 

[previewyoutube=sVue2UHNAkE;full][/previewyoutube]

Since the release of Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice  , Ninja Theory has transitioned from being an independent team to one that sits within Xbox Game Studios. Although this has seen change for Ninja Theory, particularly in terms of the support now available to us for striving towards our ambitions, what has not changed is our passion and commitment to our studio mission - to craft life-changing art with game changing tech. 

This might sound like a lofty mission, but it is something we are proud to have achieved before in Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice – a game built in a space we called ‘Independent AAA’, where we worked with the creative spirit and freedom of independent development but strove for the types of high-end production values often only associated with AAA games. We also took advantage of the freedom that digital-only distribution offered us to create a game of the length that fit perfectly with our intended experience but could be sold at a lower price to reflect the shorter length of our story. This framework  allowed us to focus on the things we really care about – taking our fans on an unforgettable journey into Senua’s unique world.

In Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II, our approach is the same. Although we are no longer an independent studio, our creative spirit has in fact been emboldened by our joining of Xbox Game Studios, and in this new chapter of Senua’s life we have been able to push our production values way beyond what we were able to achieve previously. So, my message to players is that if you loved Hellblade: Senua’s Sacrifice, or if you enjoy narrative-led experiences of cinematic immersion, we are building Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II for you. 

Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II will be a game crafted from the heart – a game similar in length to the first Hellblade, with a focused narrative, and sold digital-only at a price of $49.99 USD. And you can once again expect to join Senua in understanding her world through perception puzzles led by her experiences of psychosis, in brutal and visceral combat and in traversal gameplay, this time across the harsh but beautiful landscapes of 10th Century Iceland. Crucially, all these elements are intertwined in a unique visual and audio experience, where everything is in service of Senua’s story. So, you can expect more of the same, but this time with the support to push our ambitions for immersion, fidelity and richness far further than before. 

I’d like to take this opportunity to say thank you to all our fans across the world. Your well wishes and support is what drives us on. In Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II we want to make it as easy as possible for you all to enjoy Senua’s journey and so we have increased the breadth of our localization to 26 subtitled languages – including Arabic, Ukrainian and, of course, the language of the land of our journey: Icelandic!

Know that here at Ninja Theory, our partners and collaborators across music, mental health, art and technology are working hard to bring you, once again, a special experience. We look forward to you joining Senua’s new journey on May 21.
